name: Baseline — SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / HIPAA / GDPR
description: Baseline control catalog and event-to-control mapping rules for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR.

frameworks.name: SOC 2
frameworks.description: AICPA System and Organization Controls 2 — Trust Services Criteria covering security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27001
frameworks.description: International standard for information security management systems (ISMS). Annex A enumerates 93 controls across organisational, people, physical, and technological themes.

frameworks.name: HIPAA
frameworks.description: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act. Security Rule (45 CFR §§ 164.302–.318) defines administrative, physical, and technical safeguards for ePHI.
frameworks.version: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164, Subpart C)

frameworks.name: GDPR
frameworks.description: EU General Data Protection Regulation. Articles 25, 30, 32, 33, 34 are the audit-trail-relevant clauses: privacy by design, records of processing, security of processing, breach notification.

controls.title: Logical and physical access controls
controls.description: Implements logical access security controls to protect information assets from security events. The entity restricts logical access to information assets, including hardware, data, software, mobile devices, output, and offline system components via access control software, rule sets, and other techniques.

controls.title: New internal and external users registered + authorized
controls.description: Prior to issuing system credentials and granting system access, the entity registers and authorizes new internal and external users whose access is administered by the entity. Credentials are removed when user access is no longer authorized.

controls.title: System monitoring for anomalies
controls.description: Monitors system components and the operation of those components for anomalies indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters, and errors affecting the entity's ability to meet its objectives; anomalies are analysed to determine whether they represent security events.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures to meet its objectives.

controls.title: Vendor and business partner risk management
controls.description: Assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners. Reviews changes in services provided. Communicates risks and findings to appropriate parties.

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.description: The full life cycle of identities shall be managed.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.description: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.

controls.title: Security management process
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations.

controls.title: Information access management
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to electronic protected health information.

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain electronic PHI to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights.

controls.title: Audit controls
controls.description: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use electronic PHI.

controls.title: Data protection by design and by default
controls.description: The controller shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures designed to implement data protection principles in an effective manner and to integrate the necessary safeguards into processing.

controls.title: Records of processing activities
controls.description: Each controller shall maintain a record of processing activities under its responsibility, including categories of data subjects, recipients, transfers, retention, and a description of technical and organisational security measures.

controls.title: Security of processing
controls.description: The controller and processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk, including pseudonymisation, encryption, integrity, availability, and regular testing.

controls.title: Notification of a personal data breach
controls.description: In the case of a personal data breach, the controller shall without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it, notify the personal data breach to the supervisory authority.
